title: Practical and multifunctional
text: Practical and multifunctional. Lovely little set of pastry brushes and spatula.  I used the blue one to brush pizza sauce on a pizza, it stained it!  The rubber brittles are very soft that the larger one, I can use as pastry brush when making puff pastry and croissants pastry.  There are better ones thta don’t stain and comes off in the wash.  I hand wash all plastic tools, never trust they can withstand the heat.
